description: Pinned workflow-only SDLC source with grounded intake, reviewed delivery, scoped validation reuse, independent runtime and holdout verification, bounded repair, discovery handling, merge queues, and deterministic deployment. Factory remains a thin consumer; workflow gates own decisions and scheduling remains external.

entries.archon-backlog: Slice a PRD into an ordered backlog of issues
entries.archon-triage: Assess one request against current repository evidence
entries.archon-ship: Take a ready request through reviewed delivery
entries.archon-deliver: Deliver prepared work, or repair using native --adopt
entries.archon-verify-runtime: Verify runtime scenarios with engine-owned agents
entries.archon-discoveries: Revalidate findings and optionally publish with gh
entries.archon-merge-queue: Assess and merge an authorized batch with gh
entries.archon-lifecycle: Issue through delivery, runtime, holdout, discovery and merge
entries.archon-verify-runtime-suite: Run baseline and deliberate runtime controls
entries.archon-deploy: Roll the default branch onto a running service and read the revision back
